summary: `flightctl get devices` lists inventory (system, updated, applications, last seen); `flightctl get device/<name> -o yaml` shows labels, spec.os.image and spec.config targets, and status of OS image, rendered config version, applications, resources (cpu, disk, memory), systemInfo, summary and lastSeen.
questions: How do I list Edge Manager devices on the CLI?
How do I see a device's full spec and status?
How do I check device CPU, disk and memory health?
